title: ASML and TSMC plot a bigger canvas for building AI chips together as advanced node demand stretches
summary: ASML, TSMC and other chipmaking heavyweights are deepening collaboration on the lithography, packaging and reference design that will underpin the next generation of AI accelerators, according to a Sunday report. The work spans extreme ultraviolet scanner deployment, CoWoS-S advanced packaging capacity and high-bandwidth memory stacking, with both companies positioning themselves for sustained AI buildouts through 2027. Morgan Stanley has estimated Google could produce more than 5 million TPU chips next year on TSMC's N3P process, while Microsoft is negotiating for more than 300,000 Maia 300.
